gen-almendra-display-fs-merriweather-san: Tall lowercase makes Merriweather Sans look sturdy and large on the page, with open eyes on every e. Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary flourish up top, and that gap is the pair's best trick.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-stick: Oswald packs its rows tight and confident, a strong voice with low-contrast strokes. And Stick follows in tube-like lines of constant weight, so a long read feels smooth and modern.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-assistant: Chubbo looks drawn with a marker tip, every bend smooth and unobstructed, casual and inviting. Assistant keeps its mouths open and quiet beneath.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-suse: SUSE draws its curves from one width of stroke, with bowls tipped open toward you. And Oswald, tight and confident above it, would lose its punch if made small.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-asta-sans: Chubbo's marker-tip letters curve smoothly around every bend, casual and inviting from the first word. Asta Sans follows with tube-like constant lines and e shapes that never blot, which makes the pair feel friendly and tidy.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono gives every letter extra room on both sides. Oswald packs its rows tight and strong above, so the plain sans below feels like an easy exhale after a firm statement.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-bai-jamjuree: Inviting and casual, Chubbo draws its letters as if with a marker tip. Bai Jamjuree keeps round letters light and unpinched with no thick-and-thin shifts, a plainspoken partner that lets the heading play.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-tajawal: Tight, confident rows of strong letters set the tone, with Oswald leading and Tajawal following in a broad, open hook of a c. They split the work cleanly.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-barlow: Marker-tip friendliness, with smooth curves and no snags. Barlow answers in neon-tube strokes and c shapes whose tips pull well apart, while Chubbo earns its keep big and short.
